categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Mining' label and modifies `src/rpc/mining.cpp` and `src/node/block_template_manager.{h,cpp}` to manage `getblocktemplate` caching within `BlockTemplateManager`.
categories.rationale: Moves template caching out of process-scoped static variables and into `BlockTemplateManager` to fix potential pointer lifetime bugs in tests and remove global state. As noted in the description, this addresses tracking issue #33758 and eliminates static variables where a 'cached CBlockIndex* can outlive its ChainstateManager', representing an architectural cleanup with testability benefits rather than an urgent production template validity issue.
